1 عَلَكَهُ , (S, Msb, K,) aor.
عَلُكَ (Msb, K) and
عَلِكَ , (K,) inf. n. عَلْكٌ, (Msb,) He chewed it; (S, Msb, K;) and moved it backwards and forwards in his mouth, to chew it. (K.) ―
-b2- عَلَكَ اللِّجَامَ, (S, O, Msb, K,) aor.
عَلُكَ , (S,) or
عَلِكَ , (O,) He (a horse) chewed, or champed, the bit, (S, O, Msb,) or moved it about, (K,) in his mouth; (S, O, K;) like أَلَكَهُ. (ISd and K in art. الك.) ―
-b3- And عَلَكَ نَابَيْهِ He ground, or grated, his canine teeth, one with the other, so that a sound was produced. (K.) ―
-b4- عَلَكَتْ عَجِينَهَا She kneaded well her dough. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
